speakers.speaker: 太后
speakers.speaker_description: old#female#在寿康宫审问、敲打莞嫔是否干预朝政

speakers.speaker: 莞嫔
speakers.speaker_description: young#female#被太后审问，表明自己没有干政的私心

speakers.speaker: 惠贵人
speakers.speaker_description: young#female#在太后身旁捧盘侍奉，因见太后责怪莞嫔而试图开口解围

speakers.speaker: 紫衣妃嫔
speakers.speaker_description: young#female#在宫内刺绣，与宫女分析惠贵人为何生气离开寿康宫

speakers.speaker: 宫女
speakers.speaker_description: young#female#向小主禀报惠贵人和莞嫔离开寿康宫时的情形

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_en: Lady Huan,

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_en: Do you know your crime?

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: I am scared, I do not know.

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: Please enlighten me.

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_en: How dare you!

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_zh: 竟敢以妃嫔之身干预朝政。
dialogue.text_en: You dare to meddle in state affairs!

dialogue.speaker: 惠贵人
dialogue.text_en: Your Majesty, she...

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_en: I am asking her.

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_en: Why are you so nervous?

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_zh: 臣妾不知太后为何要这样说。
dialogue.text_en: I do not know why you say this, Your Majesty.

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: But I

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_zh: 实在不敢犯这样的死罪。
dialogue.text_en: truly dare not commit such a crime.

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_en: I allow you to explain yourself.

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_en: About the posthumous title for the late consort,

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_en: how much were you involved?

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: Empress Dowager,

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: Even though I am young and foolish,

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: I know I must not meddle in politics.

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: His Majesty is a wise ruler,

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_zh: 追封太妃之事，心中早有决断，
dialogue.text_en: He had already settled the matter of the late consort's title,

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: how could I possibly influence him?

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: I was foolish.

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_zh: 以为追封太妃是后宫之事，
dialogue.text_en: I thought it was an inner court matter,

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: so I dared to say a few words.

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: As for state affairs,

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_zh: 是绝不敢有丝毫沾染的。
dialogue.text_en: I would never dare to touch them at all.

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_zh: 纵使你无意于朝政大事，
dialogue.text_en: Even if you had no intention in state affairs,

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_en: do you dare to say

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_zh: 这件事中你没有半点私心？
dialogue.text_en: that you had no personal motive in this?

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: I dare not deceive Your Majesty.

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: His Majesty rules the nation,

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_zh: 总忧心于朝政，废寝忘食。
dialogue.text_en: and neglects himself for state affairs.

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: I am fortunate to be favored by His Majesty,

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: and able to serve by his side.

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: If I have any personal wish,

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: it is only that I hope His Majesty

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: may live long in peace.

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: and that I may also be cared for,

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: and live in peace.

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_en: This little selfish thought,

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_en: which consort in the palace does not have?

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_en: Forget it,

dialogue.speaker: 太后
dialogue.text_en: Get up.

dialogue.speaker: 莞嫔
dialogue.text_en: Thank you, Your Majesty.

dialogue.speaker: 紫衣妃嫔
dialogue.text_en: Speak.

dialogue.speaker: 宫女
dialogue.text_en: This afternoon,

dialogue.speaker: 宫女
dialogue.text_zh: 奴婢见惠贵人气冲冲从寿康宫出来，
dialogue.text_en: I saw Lady Hui come out of Shoukang Palace in anger,

dialogue.speaker: 宫女
dialogue.text_zh: 过不多久，莞嫔也出来了。
dialogue.text_en: Not long after, Lady Huan also came out.

dialogue.speaker: 宫女
dialogue.text_zh: 不知道是不是惠贵人得罪了太后呢？
dialogue.text_en: Could it be that Lady Hui offended Her Majesty?

dialogue.speaker: 紫衣妃嫔
dialogue.text_zh: 得罪太后，惠贵人怎么会生气？
dialogue.text_en: If she offended Her Majesty, why would Lady Hui be angry?

dialogue.speaker: 紫衣妃嫔
dialogue.text_en: What made Lady Hui so angry,

dialogue.speaker: 紫衣妃嫔
dialogue.text_en: is simply that she knows

dialogue.speaker: 紫衣妃嫔
dialogue.text_zh: 是莞嫔让皇上复位华妃的事。
dialogue.text_en: Consort Wan had Consort Hua restored.

dialogue.speaker: 宫女
dialogue.text_zh: 上次小主跟惠贵人这样说，
dialogue.text_en: Last time you told Lady Hui this,

dialogue.speaker: 宫女
dialogue.text_en: she still did not believe it.

dialogue.speaker: 紫衣妃嫔
dialogue.text_zh: 我说的她未必全然不信。
dialogue.text_en: It is not that she did not believe me at all.

dialogue.speaker: 紫衣妃嫔
dialogue.text_en: In everything,

dialogue.speaker: 紫衣妃嫔
dialogue.text_en: only after you get suspicious,

dialogue.speaker: 紫衣妃嫔
dialogue.text_en: and it is [confirmed],

dialogue.speaker: 紫衣妃嫔
dialogue.text_en: you get so angry.

vocab_cards.speaker: 紫衣妃嫔
vocab_cards.explanation_zh: confirm 的意思是证实、确定。原句是 and it is confirmed，意思是事情被证实了。简单例句是 The news confirmed my guess，意思是这个消息证实了我的猜想。
